theorem: An explicit integral (not merely rational/F3) PSp(4,3)-equivariant chain map sends each oriented clique edge [p,q] on its unique isotropic line L to incidence path [(p,L)]-[(q,L)]. It sends triangle boundaries to zero, is onto the Levi cycle lattice after restricting to clique cycles, and has kernel exactly the 120-rank triangle-boundary lattice. Therefore H1(clique,Z) ≅ H1(Levi,Z) naturally as G-lattices. The previously reported F3 reverse map is multiplication by 4 after this canonical map on integer building cycles, hence equals identity mod 3.
proof: On every 4-point line, the 6 oriented point-pair edges map onto the saturated sum-zero lattice of its four flags (rank3), with kernel the triangle cycle lattice (rank3). This holds integrally, independently on 40 lines. The Levi boundary of each mapped edge is the same point boundary as the source edge. Every Levi 1-cycle lies in the linewise sum-zero flag sublattice; a local integral star lift produces a closed clique chain. The kernel on clique cycles is the sum of the 40 triangle boundary lattices.
